title: JET: Just-Enough Exploration Tuning for Efficient Tool-Calling Agents in Repository-Level Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.22539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In repository-level question answering (QA), an agent explores a code repository with tools and should answer a question once enough information is gathered. Nevertheless, we find that LLM agents often continue to invoke tools even after the gathered information is already sufficient to answer. We call this phenomenon over-exploration. Moreover, even though existing methods improve task performance through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories, SFT also propagates the over-exploration in the trajectories to the agent. To mitigate over-exploration, we propose Just-Enough Exploration Tuning (JET), a fine-tuning method that trains the agent to answer once the gathered information is sufficient. translated_title: JET：面向仓库级问答中高效工具调用智能体的“刚好足够探索”调优方法
translated_abstract: 在仓库级问答任务中，智能体使用工具对代码仓库进行探索，并在收集到足够信息后应当回答问题。然而，我们发现大语言模型（LLM）智能体即使在收集的信息已足以回答问题时，仍经常继续调用工具。我们将这种现象称为“过度探索”。此外，尽管现有方法通过对专家轨迹进行监督微调（SFT）来提升任务性能，但SFT也会将专家轨迹中的过度探索行为传播给智能体。为了缓解过度探索问题，我们提出了“刚好足够探索调优”，这是一种微调方法，训练智能体在收集的信息足够时立即作答。JET在每条训练轨迹中信息变得充足的步骤处进行截断，插入一段解释智能体为何可以在该步骤回答的理由说明，并以更高的损失权重对该理由说明进行微调。
tldr: JET通过在信息充足的步骤截断训练轨迹并插入理由说明进行加权微调，有效缓解了LLM智能体在仓库级问答中的“过度探索”问题，使智能体在收集到足够信息后立即作答。
en_tdlr: JET mitigates over-exploration in LLM agents for repository-level QA by truncating training trajectories at the step where sufficient information is gathered and fine-tuning with an inserted rationale weighted more heavily, teaching agents to answer as soon as enough information is collected.
